why: countDocuments()+1 as an id races: two concurrent creates get the same number and the unique index throws an opaque E11000. Use an $inc counter document with findOneAndUpdate.
good:
const c = await counters.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: `wo:${sessionId}` }, { $inc: { n: 1 } }, { upsert: true, returnDocument: 'after' });
return `WO-${c.n}`;
